profile.audience: Invited operators evaluating existing GitHub Agentic Workflow evidence.
profile.topology: GitHub.com; one explicitly enrolled repository; GitHub Actions collection and access-restricted GitHub Pages.
profile.data: Approved evaluation evidence only; private evidence requires verified restricted dashboard access.
stop_conditions: Unexpected repository access, evidence disclosure or target mutation.
Failure of a required journey or loss of required evidence.
Recovery cannot restore the promised bounded evaluation experience.

journeys.acceptance: Install the exact candidate from verified release assets on every declared platform; verify version, provenance and a usable CLI without relying on a developer checkout.
An independent operator configures exactly the approved repository with actual administrator/App grants; denied grants fail explicitly and setup neither enrolls execution nor broadens scope.
Candidate Activity collection publishes a verified, repository-scoped snapshot; duplicate, missing, stale and partial inputs remain explicit rather than becoming successful empty evidence.
An operator opens populated Overview and Runs, follows source provenance and observes a fresh query result after collection; required desktop/mobile views preserve unknown and partial states.

Verify real restricted Pages access with an allowed and a denied viewer; withdrawing enrollment or credentials prevents further collection beyond scope without claiming previously published copies are erased.

Pause collection, diagnose an induced failure, update the candidate while preserving consumer policy/ownership, and recover the last known working experience within an explicitly agreed recovery objective.
Withdraw enrollment and credentials, stop future collection, and verify disposition of deployed snapshots, caches and retained evidence according to the agreed per-copy retention/deletion rules.

Independent invited operators complete representative monitoring tasks and assess evidence correctness/usefulness; record task denominator, assistance, time and support burden without publishing participant identities or private data.
